title: Source atlas
scenario: I18 · coordinated source selections across a table, plot and canvas
host: macOS · collaborative preview · Chromium 152 · 1280 × 800 CSS pixels
backend: Moxi Python reference scatter renderer + browser DOM
fixture: Four synthetic specimen readings and four route-owned transit stops
reproduce: From the repo root, follow the example README for the isolated runtime. Run PYTHONPATH=python .pixi/i18/bin/python examples/coordinated-representations/replay.py --output dist/i18-replay to replay the interactions. Run python3 artifacts/demo-slideshows/i18-coordinated-representations/build.py to build the gallery from the recorded originals.

slides.caption: Open the specimen collection
slides.expected: Four readings appear in each view.

slides.caption: Tab to the first source
slides.expected: S-14 has keyboard focus in the source table.

slides.caption: Press Enter on S-14
slides.expected: S-14 is selected in the table, scatter plot and slide canvas.

slides.caption: Filter to intensity ≥ 50
slides.expected: S-14 is retained as filtered while its three marks disappear.

slides.caption: Show all values
slides.expected: S-14 reappears selected in all three views.

slides.caption: Switch to group means
slides.expected: Two mean marks represent four readings; the first includes S-14.

slides.caption: Select the first mean mark
slides.expected: Both contributing sources, S-14 and S-38, are selected.

slides.caption: Try deleting the aggregate selection
slides.expected: The view explains that deletion requires one visible source.

slides.caption: Select S-38 on the slide canvas
slides.action: Select S-38 on the slide canvas
slides.expected: Only S-38 is selected; its group mean is highlighted.

slides.caption: Delete S-38
slides.expected: The S-38 reference reads deleted. Slide A now contains S-14 alone.

slides.caption: Reload the snapshot URL
slides.expected: The deletion and its source reference survive reload.

slides.caption: Open transit stops
slides.expected: The second collection maps boardings and route membership to stations.

slides.caption: Select the T-19 boarding mark
slides.expected: The Coastal station is selected in the table and schematic.

slides.caption: Group transit stops by route
slides.expected: The Coastal mean links T-02 and T-19.

slides.caption: Select the Coastal mean
slides.expected: Both Coastal stations are selected across views.
